title: New law: A joint resolution designating October 19, 1981, as a Day of National Observance of the two Hundredth Anniversary of the Surrender of Lord Cornwallis to General George Washington at Yorktown Virginia. (Public Law 96-414)
summary: H.J.Res. 472 of the 96th Congress became Public Law 96-414 on 1980-10-09.
